poem.author: 贺知章
englishLines: A tall willow is dressed in emerald green,
Ten thousand branches hang like green silk ribbons.
Who has cut out all these slender leaves?
The early-spring wind is a pair of scissors.

appreciation.zh: 新柳像碧玉装扮成的大树，垂下无数柔软的绿丝带。诗人把看不见的春风想成一把灵巧的剪刀，裁出了满树细叶。
appreciation.en: The new willow looks dressed in jade, trailing countless green ribbons. The poet imagines the invisible spring wind as clever scissors cutting every slender leaf.

pages.zhText:
碧玉妆成一树高，
万条垂下绿丝绦。
不知细叶谁裁出，
二月春风似剪刀。
pages.enText:
A tall willow is dressed in emerald green,
Ten thousand branches hang like green silk ribbons.
Who has cut out all these slender leaves?
The early-spring wind is a pair of scissors.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Towering fresh green willow beside a calm Tang village stream in early spring, long supple branches flowing like ribbons, a cheerful elderly Tang poet in pale blue-gray robe looks up in delight, mineral green focal color, no literal scissors, no text.

pages.zhText:
碧玉妆成一树高，
高高的柳树披上嫩绿的新叶，像一整块温润的碧玉。
pages.enText:
A tall willow is dressed in emerald green.
Fresh leaves clothe the whole tree like glowing jade.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Low-angle view up the same tall willow crowned with translucent jade-green young leaves, same elderly poet small at trunk, pale spring sky and generous negative space, no jewelry or text.

pages.zhText:
万条垂下绿丝绦。
细长的柳条轻轻垂下，在风里像绿色丝带一样摇摆。
pages.enText:
Ten thousand branches hang like green silk ribbons.
Long willow twigs sway softly like green ribbons.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Medium-wide riverside view emphasizing thousands of long willow branches drifting in one gentle breeze like soft green ribbons, same poet walking beneath without touching branches, no actual fabric ribbons, no text.

pages.zhText:
不知细叶谁裁出，
一片片小叶子这样整齐，是谁把它们做出来的呢？
pages.enText:
Who has cut out all these slender leaves?
Who could have shaped so many neat little leaves?
pages.illustrationPrompt: Child-friendly close view of same poet examining one slender willow leaf with curious smile, many distinct young leaves and buds around him, delicate natural edges, no tools or text.

pages.zhText:
二月春风似剪刀。
原来是二月的春风，用轻轻的手势裁出了满树新绿。
pages.enText:
The early-spring wind is a pair of scissors.
The February breeze seems to shape a whole tree of green.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Whimsical but natural wind made visible only through curling ink-wash currents moving among willow leaves, leaves seeming neatly shaped as branches sway, same poet laughing softly, absolutely no literal scissors, no text.

pages.zhText: 春风吹过水面，又穿过柳条。树梢到枝尖，一片片新叶都醒来了。
pages.enText: Spring wind crosses the water and slips through the willow. From crown to twig, new leaves wake one by one.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Panoramic same stream and willow, breeze travels as ripples from water upward through branches, fresh leaves opening across the tree, same poet follows the movement with his gaze, no text.

pages.zhText: 看不见的风，也能留下看得见的作品。诗人抬头一想，春天忽然变得又聪明又好玩。
pages.enText: Invisible wind can leave visible handiwork. With one playful thought, spring becomes clever and full of fun.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Warm playful portrait under willow canopy, same poet smiles as a few leaves flutter around him, light and shadow form gentle scissor-like crossing shapes without an object, no text.

pages.zhText:
碧玉妆成一树高，
万条垂下绿丝绦。
不知细叶谁裁出，
二月春风似剪刀。
再轻轻读一遍吧。
pages.enText:
A tall willow is dressed in emerald green,
Ten thousand branches hang like green silk ribbons.
Who has cut out all these slender leaves?
The early-spring wind is a pair of scissors.
Now read it softly once more.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Closing bright early-spring view of complete willow reflected in stream, long branches dancing, same poet heading home across simple stone footbridge, abundant airy green, no text.
